summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, finished-time capture, Palette.__rich__, tests, and changelog. Tests were not run (per instructions); the test_columns expected output was derived by hand from a clock-read trace and verified only by counting glyphs and cells (264 bar glyphs, 12 elapsed cells). Column list and expected output were edited together. Palette headers are "Index", "RGB", "Color" (my choice). A second changelog line for Palette.__rich__ was added beyond the requested TimeElapsedColumn entry.
